sources.title: Q2 2026 issuer financial update
sources.supports: adjusted earnings of $9.8bn and cash flow from operations of $21.4bn; the quarterly commodity-driven result is not annualized. Shell has publicly described C3 AI predictive-mainten

sources.title: Annual report / financial results
sources.supports: latest financial anchor used in packet

financial_anchor.caveat: Non-GAAP post-tax measure; commodity-sensitive. Q2 2026 is latest interim and not annualized.

ai_claim.claim: Shell describes scoped AI/digital mechanisms in seismic/reservoir interpretation and well planning, predictive maintenance and process optimization.
ai_claim.stage: E1; E2 only where management explicitly reports production use
ai_claim.scope: nonproductive rig time, recovery/production at fixed geology and capital, unplanned downtime, energy per unit and risk-adjusted trading outcome
ai_claim.limitation: No controlled quality-adjusted company result tied to retained incremental cash was found.

strongest_counterevidence.claim: BP and oilfield-service digital platforms and hyperscaler industrial AI can replicate tools or force gains through to customers.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Competitive capability does not by itself prove equal outcomes.

rights_limit: Shell controls internal asset data, while joint ventures, host governments and service contracts can restrict use. Trading/customer data are regulated and purpose-limited.
materiality_summary: 5% of FY2025 adjusted earnings is $925m per year; Q2 2026 strength is commodity/trading-driven.

arithmetic.result: $925m annual hurdle; no AI-attributed cash result.

g2_provisional: Open: E1/E2 evidence supports measurement, but E3 quality-adjusted causality and E4 cash retention are not established.
unresolved_questions: What share of eligible workload is in production?
What controlled quality-adjusted KPI result exists?
What do contracts permit for pooled learning and how much benefit is retained after recurring cost?
